import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval

import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
#check_failure Roth.eq_sum_X_none_pow_mul_coeffNone
namespace Expansion156Guards
theorem semiring_expansion {A : Type*} [Semiring A] (p : Polynomial A) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : p.natDegree < n) :
    p = ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range n, Polynomial.C (p.coeff ν) * Polynomial.X ^ ν :=
  p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' hn
theorem bound_guard :
    (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℕ) ≠
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range 1, Polynomial.C ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℕ).coeff ν) *
        Polynomial.X ^ ν := by
  simp
theorem endpoint_guard :
    (Polynomial.C 1 : Polynomial ℕ) ≠
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range 0, Polynomial.C ((Polynomial.C 1 : Polynomial ℕ).coeff ν) *
        Polynomial.X ^ ν := by
  simp
#print axioms semiring_expansion
#print axioms bound_guard
#print axioms endpoint_guard
end Expansion156Guards
